H1100.def: from «01097» and «03276»; without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness (often in connection with «0376», «0802», «01121», etc.):--Belial, evil, naughty, ungodly (men), wicked.

H1101.def: a primitive root; to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; also (denominatively from «01098») to fodder:--anoint, confound, × fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.

H1102.def: a primitive root; to muzzle:--be held in.

H1103.def: a primitive root; to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them):--gatherer.

H1104.def: a primitive root; to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy:--cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).

H1105.def: from «01104»; a gulp; figuratively, destruction:--devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.

H1106.def: the same as «01105»; Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites:--Bela.

H1107.def: or balmadey {bal-ad-ay'}; constructive plural from «01077» and «05703», not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb) except, without, besides:--beside, not (in), save, without.

H1108.def: patronymically from «01106»: a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela:--Belaites.

H1109.def: probably from «01077» and «05971»; not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner; Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine:--Balaam, Bileam.

H1110.def: a primitive root; to annihilate:--(make) waste.

H1111.def: from «01110»; waster; Balak, a Moabitish king:--Balak.

H1112.def: or Belshatstsar {bale-shats-tsar'}; of foreign origin (compare «01095»); Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king:--Belshazzar.

H1114.def: of uncertain derivation; Bilshan, an Israelite:--Bilshan.

H1115.def: constructive feminine of «01086» (equivalent to «01097»); properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.:--because un(satiable), beside, but, + continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.

H1116.et: from an unused root (meaning to be high)
H1116.def: from an unused root (meaning to be high); an elevation:--height, high place, wave.

H1117.def: the same as «01116»; Bamah, a place in Palestine:--Bamah. See also «01120».

H1118.def: probably from «04107» with prepositional prefix; with pruning; Bimhal, an Israelite:--Bimhal.

H1119.def: prolongation for prepositional prefix; in, with, by, etc.:--for, in into, through.

H1120.def: plural of «01116»; heights; or (fully) Bamowth Bahal {baw-moth' bah'-al}; from the same and «01168»; heights of Baal; Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan:--Bamoth, Bamoth-baal.

H1121.def: from «01129»; a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like «01», «0251», etc.)):--+ afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-)ite, (anoint-)ed one, appointed to, (+) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-)ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, + (young) bullock, + (young) calf, × came up in, child, colt, × common, × corn, daughter, × of first, + firstborn, foal, + very fruitful, + postage, × in, + kid, + lamb, (+) man, meet, + mighty, + nephew, old, (+) people, + rebel, + robber, × servant born, × soldier, son, + spark, + steward, + stranger, × surely, the

H1122.def: the same as «01121»; Ben, an Israelite:--Ben.

H1124.def: (Aramaic) or bnah (Aramaic) {ben-aw'}; corresponding to «01129»; to build:--build, make.

H1125.def: from «01121» and «040»; (the) son of Abinadab; Ben-Abinadab, an Israelite:--the son of Abinadab.

H1126.def: from «01121» and «0205»; son of my sorrow; Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin:--Ben-oni.

H1127.def: from «01121» and «01397»; son of (the) hero; Ben- Geber, an Israelite:--the son of Geber.

H1128.def: from «01121» and a derivative of «01856»; son of piercing (or of a lance); Ben-Deker, an Israelite:--the son of Dekar.

H1129.def: a primitive root; to build (literally and figuratively):--(begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), × surely.

H1130.def: from «01121» and «01908»; son of Hadad; Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings:--Ben-hadad.

H1131.def: from «01129»; built up; Binnui, an Israelite:--Binnui.

H1132.def: from «01121» and «02105»; son of Zocheth; Ben- Zocheth, an Israelite:--Ben-zoketh.

H1133.def: from «01121» and «02354»; son of Chur; Ben-Chur, an Israelite:--the son of Hur.

H1134.def: from «01121» and «02428»; son of might; Ben-Chail, an Israelite:--Ben-hail.

H1135.def: from «01121» and «02605»; son of Chanan; Ben- Chanan, an Israelite:--Ben-hanan.

H1136.def: from «01121» and «02617»; son of kindness; Ben- Chesed, an Israelite:--the son of Hesed.

H1137.def: from «01129»; built; Bani, the name of five Israelites:--Bani.

H1138.def: or (fuller) Buwniy {boo-nee'}; from «01129»; built; Bunni or Buni, an Israelite:--Bunni.

H1139.et: from the plural construction of (01121) and (01300)
H1139.def: from the plural construction of «01121» and «01300»; sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine:--Bene-barak.

H1141.def: or (prolonged) Bnayahuw {ben-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «01129» and «03050»; Jah has built; Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites:-- Benaiah.

H1142.def: from the plural of «01121» and «03292»; sons of Yaakan; Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert:--Bene-jaakan.

H1143.def: dual of «0996»; a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies:--+ champion.

H1144.def: from «01121» and «03225»; son of (the) right hand; Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:--Benjamin.

H1145.et: sometimes (with article inserted) Ben-ha-y@miniy {ben-hah-yem-ee-nee'}with (0376) inserted ((1)">1) Sa (9):1) Ben-'iysh Y@miyniy {ben-eesh' yem-ee-nee'}
H1145.def: sometimes (with the article inserted) Ben-ha-yminiy {ben-hah-yem-ee-nee'}; with «0376» inserted (1 Sam. 9:1) Ben-miysh Ymiyniy {ben-eesh' yem-ee-nee'}; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened (1 Sam. 9:4; Esth. 2:5) eIysh Ymiyniy {eesh yem-ee-nee'}; a man of Jemini, or (1 Sam. 20:1) simply Yminiy {yem-ee-nee'}; a Jeminite; (plural Bniy Ymiyniy {ben- ay' yem-ee-nee'}; patron from «01144»; a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin:--Benjamite, of Benjamin.

H1148.def: probably from «01121» with pron. suff.; our son; Beninu, an Israelite:--Beninu.

H1149.def: (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity; to be enraged:--be angry.

H1150.def: or Bincah {bin-aw'}; of uncertain derivation; Bina or Binah, an Israelite:--Binea, Bineah.

H1151.def: from «01121» and «05971» with pronomial suffix; son of my people; Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot:--Ben-ammi.

H1152.def: from «05475» and «03050» with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodejah, an Israelite:--Besodeiah.

H1153.def: from «0947»; domineering; Besai, one of the Nethinim:--Besai.

H1154.et: from an unused root meaning to be sour
H1154.def: from an unused root meaning to be sour; an immature grape:--unripe grape.

H1156.def: (Aramaic) or b ah (Aramaic) {beh-aw'}; corresponding to «01158»; to seek or ask:--ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.

H1157.def: from «05704» with prepositional prefix; in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.:--about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

H1158.def: a primitive root; to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask:--cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.

H1160.def: from «01197» (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam:--Beor.

H1162.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H1162.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple:--Boaz.

H1163.def: a primitive root; to trample down, i.e. (figuratively) despise:--kick.

H1165.def: from «01197» (in the sense of eating): cattle:--beast, cattle.

H1166.def: a primitive root; to be master; hence, (as denominative from «01167») to marry:--have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, × wife).

H1167.def: from «01166»; a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense):--+ archer, + babbler, + bird, captain, chief man, + confederate, + have to do, + dreamer, those to whom it is due, + furious, those that are given to it, great, + hairy, he that hath it, have, + horseman, husband, lord, man, + married, master, person, + sworn, they of.

H1168.def: the same as «01167»; Baal, a Phoenician deity:--Baal, (plural) Baalim.

H1170.def: from «01168» and «01285»; Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites:--Baal-berith.

H1171.def: from «01168» and «01409»; Baal of Fortune; Baal-Gad, a place in Syria:--Baal-gad.

H1172.def: feminine of «01167»; a mistress:--that hath, mistress.

H1173.def: the same as «01172»; Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine:--Baalah.

H1174.def: from «01167» and «01995»; possessor of a multitude; Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine:--Baal-hamon.

H1175.def: plural of «01172»; mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine:--Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from «05927» with prepositional prefix).

H1176.def: from «01168» and «02070»; Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites:--Baal-zebub.

H1177.def: from «01167» and «02603»; possessor of grace; Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite:--Baal-hanan.

H1178.def: from «01167» and a modification of «02691»; possessor of a village; Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine:--Baal-hazor.

H1179.def: from «01167» and «02768»; possessor of Hermon; Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine:--Baal-hermon.

H1180.def: from «01167» with pron. suff.; my master; Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah:--Baali.

H1181.et: from the pl. of (01168) and the pl. of (01116)
H1181.def: from the plural of «01168» and the plural of «01116»; Baals of (the) heights; Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan:--lords of the high places.

H1182.def: from «01168» and «03045»; Baal has known; Beeljada, an Israelite:--Beeliada.

H1183.def: from «01167» and «03050»; Jah (is) master; Bealjah, an Israelite:--Bealiah.

H1184.def: from the plural of «01167» and «03063»; masters of Judah; Baale-Jehudah, a place in Palestine:--Baale of Judah.

H1185.et: probably from a derivative of (05965) with prepositional prefix
H1185.def: probably from a derivative of «05965» with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis, an Ammonitish king:--Baalis.

H1186.def: from «01168» and «04583»; Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare «01010»); Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan:--Baal-meon.

H1187.def: from «01168» and «06465»; Baal of Peor; Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity:--Baal-peor.

H1188.def: from «01167» and the plural of «06556»; possessor of breaches; Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine:--Baal- perazim.

H1189.def: from «01168» and «06828» (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter; Baal-Tsephon, a place in Eqypt:--Baal-zephon.

H1190.def: from «01168» and «08031»; Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine:--Baal-shalisha.

H1191.def: a modification of «01172»; mistressship; Baalath, a place in Palestine:--Baalath.

H1192.def: from «01172» and «0875»; mistress of a well; Baalath-Beer, a place in Palestine:--Baalath-beer.

H1193.def: from «01167» and «08558»; possessor of (the) palm-tree; Baal-Tamar, a place in Palestine:--Baal-tamar.

H1194.def: probably a contraction of «01010»; Beon, a place East of the Jordan:--Beon.

H1195.def: the same as «01196»; Banana, the name of four Israelite:--Baana, Baanah.

H1196.et: from a derivative of (06031) with prepositional prefix
H1196.def: from a derivative of «06031» with prepositional prefix; in affliction:--Baanah, the name of four Israelites:--Baanah.

H1197.def: a primitive root; to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); also (as denominative from «01198») to be(-come) brutish:--be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set ((on fire)), waste.

H1198.def: from «01197»; properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid:--brutish (person), foolish.

H1199.def: from «01198»; brutish: Baara, an Israelitish woman:--Baara.
